source_title: GTA 6 Officially Confirms Insane Number of NPC Animations and Behaviors
source_excerpt:
Rockstar Games has revealed the immense number of unique animations and behaviors for Grand Theft Auto 6 's NPCs, with more than 600,000 ways for pedestrians to react to different situations. The intense attention to detail in Grand Theft Auto 6 comes with one of Rockstar's most in-depth and detailed worlds yet.
The newest entry in Rockstar's beloved open-world franchise has already shown off an incredibly deep in-game world. GTA 6 expands far beyond the neon-lit streets of Vice City, allowing players to explore the entire state of Leonida and visit Rockstar's interpretation of locations like the Everglades and the Florida Keys. The game is expected to feature numerous interior environments as well, ranging from Jason and Lucia's apartments to clubs, businesses, and more. Now, Rockstar's immersive world will extend to its cast of pedestrian NPCs, featuring plenty of ways to react to the player's actions.
GTA 6 Has More Than 600,000 NPC Animations
Dominik Bošnjak / GameRant | Source image: Rockstar Games
In a recent interview with Edge Magazine , Rockstar shared the extent of its NPC animations in Grand Theft Auto 6 . Rockstar revealed that the studio created a dedicated internal team to handle the NPC residents of GTA 6 's Leonida , with more than 600,000 different animations developed for its non-player characters. Each NPC will also have their own personality traits within the game, causing pedestrians in GTA 6 to react differently based on their own demeanor and aggression levels. Rockstar North's co-studio head, Rob Nelson, shared more information about the process behind creating GTA 6 's NPCs, determining how aggressive NPCs will be or whether they will go for a weapon.
Tap on a weapon to rotate it or press R while dragging.
GTA 6 's lineup of pedestrian NPCs is set to be one of its most vibrant yet, going even more in-depth than their assortment of animations. Rockstar has reportedly developed a sizable library of dialogue for GTA 6 's NPCs , including differences in an NPC's tone affected by factors like weather, time of day, and the player committing a crime. Red Dead Redemption 2 saw a similarly massive amount of dialogue for its non-player characters, with Arthur able to directly interact with NPCs who do not play a role in the larger story of the game.

Grand Theft Auto 6 looks to be a groundbreaking game for the open-world franchise, for more than just its NPCs. Rockstar revealed some notable information about the progression of GTA 6 's story during the game's Extended Look trailer, including story missions having multiple ways to be completed. The studio also revealed that it had heavily considered getting rid of the weapon wheel used in recent GTA games, aiming for a deeper sense of immersion, but ultimately decided to retain the mechanic. Grand Theft Auto 6 is scheduled to officially release on November 19.
With GTA 6 's long-awaited launch just weeks away, the game is shaping up to be a huge financial success for Rockstar. A recent report revealed that Rockstar has already sold 6 million copies of GTA 6 , crossing the massive milestone just through the game's pre-orders. The sales numbers also corroborate earlier claims that the game's PlayStation 5 version is outselling the Xbox version by a wide margin, with GTA 6 on PS5 reportedly pre-selling 4.8 million copies while the Xbox Series X/S version has sold 1.66 million copies. Grand Theft Auto 6 fans won't have to wait much longer to finally return to the streets of Vice City.
